category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Olympian Gods
clue_en: According to Greek myth, which king of the gods hurls thunderbolts?
clue_et: Milline jumalate kuningas heidab Kreeka mütoloogia järgi välgunooli?
explanation_en: Greek tradition makes Zeus ruler of Olympus and god of the sky, thunder and lightning.
explanation_et: Kreeka pärimuses on Zeus Olümpose valitseja ning taeva, kõue ja välgu jumal.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Olympian Gods
clue_en: Which trident-carrying brother of Zeus rules the sea in Greek myth?
clue_et: Milline kolmharki kandev Zeusi vend valitseb Kreeka mütoloogias merd?
explanation_en: Poseidon is the Greek god of the sea, earthquakes and horses, and his emblem is the trident.
explanation_et: Poseidon on Kreeka mere-, maavärina- ja hobujumal, kelle tunnus on kolmhark.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Olympian Gods
clue_en: Which goddess of wisdom and strategy gave her name to the city of Athens?
clue_et: Milline tarkuse ja sõjastrateegia jumalanna andis nime Ateena linnale?
explanation_en: Athena was the patron goddess of Athens, whose Parthenon honoured her on the Acropolis.
explanation_et: Athena oli Ateena kaitsejumalanna ning talle pühendati akropolil Parthenon.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Olympian Gods
clue_en: Which twin sister of Apollo is the Greek goddess of the hunt and wild animals?
clue_et: Milline Apolloni kaksikõde on Kreeka jahi ja metsloomade jumalanna?
explanation_en: Artemis is a virgin huntress in Greek religion and is commonly shown with a bow and deer.
explanation_et: Artemis on Kreeka usundis neitsilik jahijumalanna, keda kujutatakse sageli vibu ja hirvega.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Olympian Gods
clue_en: Which divine smith forges armour and weapons for the gods?
clue_et: Milline jumalik sepp valmistab jumalatele soomusrüüsid ja relvi?
explanation_en: Hephaestus is the Greek god of fire, metalworking and craftsmanship, with a workshop imagined beneath volcanoes.
explanation_et: Hephaistos on Kreeka tule-, metallitöö- ja käsitööjumal, kelle sepikoda kujutleti vulkaanide alla.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Heroes of Greek Myth
clue_en: Which hero performed twelve labours, including defeating the Nemean Lion?
clue_et: Milline kangelane sooritas kaksteist vägitegu, sealhulgas alistas Nemea lõvi?
explanation_en: Heracles completed the famous labours as service to King Eurystheus in Greek myth.
explanation_et: Herakles täitis Kreeka mütoloogias kuulsad vägiteod kuningas Eurystheuse teenistuses.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Heroes of Greek Myth
clue_en: Which greatest Greek warrior at Troy gave us a phrase for a fatal weak point?
clue_et: Milline Trooja sõja kreeklaste suurim sõdalane andis meile väljendi saatusliku nõrga koha kohta?
explanation_en: Later tradition said Achilles was vulnerable at the heel, creating the expression “Achilles’ heel”.
explanation_et: Hilisema pärimuse järgi oli Achilleus haavatav kannast, millest tuleb väljend „Achilleuse kand”.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Heroes of Greek Myth
clue_en: Which clever king spends years trying to return home to Ithaca after the Trojan War?
clue_et: Milline kaval kuningas püüab pärast Trooja sõda aastaid koju Ithakale naasta?
explanation_en: Homer’s Odyssey follows Odysseus through many dangers on his voyage back to Ithaca.
explanation_et: Homerose „Odüsseia” jälgib Odysseust tema ohtlikul mereretkel tagasi Ithakale.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Heroes of Greek Myth
clue_en: Which hero beheaded Medusa while looking at her reflection in a polished shield?
clue_et: Milline kangelane raius Medusal pea maha, vaadates tema peegeldust poleeritud kilbilt?
explanation_en: Athena’s reflective shield helped Perseus avoid Medusa’s petrifying direct gaze.
explanation_et: Athena peegeldav kilp aitas Perseusel vältida Medusa kivistavat otsest pilku.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Heroes of Greek Myth
clue_en: Which Athenian hero entered the Cretan labyrinth and killed the Minotaur?
clue_et: Milline Ateena kangelane sisenes Kreeta labürinti ja tappis Minotaurose?
explanation_en: Ariadne gave Theseus a thread so he could find his way out after confronting the Minotaur.
explanation_et: Ariadne andis Theseusele lõnga, et too pärast Minotaurosega võitlemist väljapääsu leiaks.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Creatures of Greek Myth
clue_en: Which snake-haired Gorgon turned those who looked directly at her to stone?
clue_et: Milline madude juustega gorgo muutis talle otsa vaatajad kiviks?
explanation_en: Medusa is the mortal Gorgon whose severed head retained its petrifying power.
explanation_et: Medusa on surelik gorgo, kelle maharaiutud pea säilitas kivistava jõu.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Creatures of Greek Myth
clue_en: Which winged horse sprang from Medusa’s blood and later carried the hero Bellerophon?
clue_et: Milline tiivuline hobune sündis Medusa verest ja kandis hiljem kangelast Bellerophontest?
explanation_en: Pegasus is the divine winged horse associated with Bellerophon and the defeat of the Chimera.
explanation_et: Pegasos on jumalik tiivuline hobune, keda seostatakse Bellerophontese ja Kimääri alistamisega.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Creatures of Greek Myth
clue_en: Which bull-headed creature lived at the centre of the Cretan labyrinth?
clue_et: Milline härjapeaga olend elas Kreeta labürindi keskmes?
explanation_en: Greek myth describes the Minotaur as a human-bodied, bull-headed being confined in the labyrinth.
explanation_et: Kreeka müüt kirjeldab Minotaurost inimkeha ja härjapeaga olendina, kes suleti labürinti.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Creatures of Greek Myth
clue_en: What one-eyed giant traps Odysseus and his crew in a cave in the Odyssey?
clue_et: Milline ühesilmne hiiglane vangistab „Odüsseias” Odysseuse ja tema mehed koopasse?
explanation_en: Polyphemus is a Cyclops whom Odysseus blinds in order to escape from the cave.
explanation_et: Polyphēmos on kükloop, kelle Odysseus koopast pääsemiseks pimestab.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Creatures of Greek Myth
clue_en: Which multi-headed watchdog guards the entrance to Hades?
clue_et: Milline mitme peaga valvekoer valvab Hadese sissepääsu?
explanation_en: Cerberus prevents the dead from leaving the underworld and the living from entering freely.
explanation_et: Kerberos takistab surnutel allilmast lahkuda ja elavatel sinna vabalt siseneda.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Roman Gods
clue_en: Which Roman ruler of the gods corresponds to the Greek Zeus?
clue_et: Milline Rooma jumalate valitseja vastab Kreeka Zeusile?
explanation_en: Jupiter was Rome’s chief sky and thunder god and was identified with Zeus.
explanation_et: Jupiter oli Rooma peamine taeva- ja kõuejumal ning teda samastati Zeusiga.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Roman Gods
clue_en: Which Roman sea god carries a trident and corresponds to Poseidon?
clue_et: Milline Rooma merejumal kannab kolmharki ja vastab Poseidonile?
explanation_en: Roman Neptune was associated with fresh water and the sea and became equated with Greek Poseidon.
explanation_et: Rooma Neptunust seostati magevee ja merega ning ta samastati Kreeka Poseidoniga.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Roman Gods
clue_en: Which Roman goddess of love gave her name to the brightest planet seen from Earth?
clue_et: Milline Rooma armastusjumalanna andis nime Maalt nähtavale kõige heledamale planeedile?
explanation_en: Venus was the Roman goddess of love and beauty; the planet carries her Latin name.
explanation_et: Venus oli Rooma armastuse ja ilu jumalanna; planeet kannab tema ladinakeelset nime.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Roman Gods
clue_en: Which Roman war god was regarded as the father of Romulus and Remus?
clue_et: Millist Rooma sõjajumalat peeti Romuluse ja Remuse isaks?
explanation_en: In Rome’s foundation myth, Mars fathered the twins Romulus and Remus with Rhea Silvia.
explanation_et: Rooma asutamismüüdis sai Mars Rhea Silviaga kaksikute Romuluse ja Remuse isaks.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Roman Gods
clue_en: Which swift Roman messenger god is commonly shown with winged sandals?
clue_et: Millist kiiret Rooma sõnumitoojajumalat kujutatakse tavaliselt tiivuliste sandaalidega?
explanation_en: Mercury was patron of merchants and travellers as well as the gods’ messenger, corresponding to Hermes.
explanation_et: Mercurius oli kaupmeeste ja rändurite kaitsja ning jumalate sõnumitooja, vastates Hermesele.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Norse Gods
clue_en: Which thunder god wields the hammer Mjölnir?
clue_et: Milline kõuejumal kannab vasarat Mjölnir?
explanation_en: In Norse tradition, Thor uses Mjölnir against giants and to protect gods and humans.
explanation_et: Põhjala pärimuses kasutab Thor Mjölniri hiiglaste vastu ning jumalate ja inimeste kaitseks.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Norse Gods
clue_en: Which beloved Norse god is killed by a weapon made from mistletoe?
clue_et: Milline armastatud Põhjala jumal hukkub puuvõõrikust valmistatud relva läbi?
explanation_en: Loki arranges for the blind god Höðr to throw the mistletoe weapon that kills Baldr.
explanation_et: Loki korraldab nii, et pime jumal Höðr heidab Baldri tapva puuvõõrikurelva.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Norse Gods
clue_en: Which cunning figure repeatedly helps and harms the gods through tricks and shape-shifting?
clue_et: Milline kaval tegelane kord aitab ja kord kahjustab jumalaid trikkide ning kujumuutmisega?
explanation_en: Loki is an ambivalent trickster whose schemes solve some crises and cause others in Norse stories.
explanation_et: Loki on kahetine trikster, kelle sepitsused lahendavad Põhjala lugudes mõne kriisi ja põhjustavad teisi.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Norse Gods
clue_en: Which goddess associated with love, beauty and seiðr magic rides in a cat-drawn chariot?
clue_et: Milline armastuse, ilu ja seiðr-maagiaga seotud jumalanna sõidab kasside veetavas kaarikus?
explanation_en: Freyja belongs to the Vanir and is associated with love, fertility, battle and magical practice.
explanation_et: Freyja kuulub vaanide hulka ning teda seostatakse armastuse, viljakuse, lahingu ja maagiaga.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Norse Gods
clue_en: Which god loses a hand when the wolf Fenrir realises the gods have bound him?
clue_et: Milline jumal kaotab käe, kui hunt Fenrir mõistab, et jumalad on ta kinni sidunud?
explanation_en: Týr placed his hand in Fenrir’s mouth as a pledge and paid the price when the binding held.
explanation_et: Tyr pani pandiks käe Fenriri suhu ning maksis selle hinna, kui side vastu pidas.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Creatures of Norse Myth
clue_en: Which monstrous wolf is bound by the gods until Ragnarök?
clue_et: Millise koletisliku hundi seovad jumalad kinni kuni Ragnarökini?
explanation_en: The gods fear Fenrir’s strength and use the magical fetter Gleipnir to restrain him.
explanation_et: Jumalad kardavad Fenriri jõudu ja kasutavad tema kinnipidamiseks võlusidet Gleipnir.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Creatures of Norse Myth
clue_en: Which world serpent circles Midgard beneath the ocean and is Thor’s great enemy?
clue_et: Milline maailmamadu ümbritseb ookeanis Midgardi ja on Thori suur vaenlane?
explanation_en: Jörmungandr is so vast that it encircles the human world and grasps its own tail.
explanation_et: Jörmungandr on nii hiiglaslik, et ümbritseb inimeste maailma ja hoiab oma saba suus.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Creatures of Norse Myth
clue_en: Which eight-legged horse carries Odin between worlds?
clue_et: Milline kaheksajalgne hobune kannab Odinit maailmade vahel?
explanation_en: Sleipnir is Odin’s exceptionally swift grey horse and a child of Loki in Norse myth.
explanation_et: Sleipnir on Odini erakordselt kiire hall hobune ja Põhjala müüdis Loki laps.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Creatures of Norse Myth
clue_en: Which female beings choose fallen warriors on the battlefield and take some of them to Valhalla?
clue_et: Millised naisolevused valivad lahinguväljal langenud sõdalasi ja viivad osa neist Valhallasse?
explanation_en: Valkyries serve Odin by choosing slain warriors, some of whom join the einherjar in Valhalla.
explanation_et: Valküürid teenivad Odinit, valides langenud sõdalasi, kellest osa liitub Valhallas einherjar’idega.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Creatures of Norse Myth
clue_en: Which famously skilled beings forge Thor’s hammer Mjölnir after Loki wagers his head on a contest?
clue_et: Millised meisterlike oskuste poolest tuntud olendid sepistavad Thori vasara Mjölniri pärast seda, kui Loki paneb võistluses kaalule oma pea?
explanation_en: The dwarf brothers Brokkr and Eitri forge Mjölnir during a contest to create treasures for the gods.
explanation_et: Päkapikuvennad Brokkr ja Eitri sepistavad Mjölniri jumalatele aarete loomise võistluse käigus.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Gods of Ancient Egypt
clue_en: Which ancient Egyptian sun god crosses the sky in a divine boat?
clue_et: Milline Vana-Egiptuse päikesejumal sõidab üle taeva päikeselaevas?
explanation_en: Egyptian tradition imagined Ra crossing the daytime sky and journeying through the underworld at night.
explanation_et: Egiptuse pärimus kujutles Ra’d päeval üle taeva ja öösel läbi allilma rändamas.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Gods of Ancient Egypt
clue_en: Which jackal-headed god is linked with embalming and guiding the dead?
clue_et: Milline šaakalipeaga jumal on seotud palsameerimise ja surnute juhatamisega?
explanation_en: Anubis presides over mummification and helps conduct the judgement of the dead.
explanation_et: Anubis valvab mumifitseerimist ja aitab läbi viia surnute kohtumõistmist.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Gods of Ancient Egypt
clue_en: Which murdered and restored ruler became god of the afterlife and judge of the dead?
clue_et: Millisest tapetud ja taastatud valitsejast sai allilmajumal ning surnute kohtumõistja?
explanation_en: The myth of Osiris’s death and restoration connected him with rebirth and the afterlife.
explanation_et: Müüt Osirise surmast ja taastamisest sidus ta taassünni ja teispoolsusega.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Gods of Ancient Egypt
clue_en: Which powerful goddess restores her husband Osiris and protects their son Horus?
clue_et: Milline vägev jumalanna taastab oma abikaasa Osirise ja kaitseb nende poega Horost?
explanation_en: Isis is celebrated as a skilled magician, devoted wife and protective mother in Egyptian tradition.
explanation_et: Egiptuse pärimuses austatakse Isist osava võluri, pühendunud abikaasa ja kaitsva emana.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Gods of Ancient Egypt
clue_en: Which falcon-headed god defeats Set and is closely tied to the living pharaoh?
clue_et: Milline pistrikupäine jumal alistab Sethi ja on tihedalt seotud elava vaaraoga?
explanation_en: Egyptian kings were identified with Horus, whose conflict with Set restored rightful rule.
explanation_et: Egiptuse kuningaid samastati Horusega, kelle võitlus Sethiga taastas õiguspärase võimu.

clue_en: Which legendary British king gathers the Knights of the Round Table at Camelot?
clue_et: Milline legendaarne Briti kuningas koondab Camelotis ümarlaua rüütlid?
explanation_en: Arthurian legend makes Arthur the ruler of Camelot and centre of the Round Table fellowship.
explanation_et: Arturi-legendides on Arthur Cameloti valitseja ja ümarlaua vennaskonna keskne kuju.

clue_en: What is the name of Arthur’s magical sword?
clue_et: Mis on Arthuri võlumõõga nimi?
explanation_en: Excalibur is Arthur’s legendary sword, often given to him by the Lady of the Lake.
explanation_et: Excalibur on Arthuri legendaarne mõõk, mille annab talle sageli Järvedaam.

clue_en: Which wizard advises Arthur and is associated with the prophecy of the future king?
clue_et: Milline võlur nõustab Arthurit ja on seotud tulevase kuninga ennustusega?
explanation_en: Merlin developed from a figure in medieval Welsh tradition into Arthur’s magician and counsellor.
explanation_et: Merlin kujunes keskaegse Walesi pärimuse tegelasest Arthuri võluriks ja nõuandjaks.

clue_en: Which Scottish and Irish folklore being leaves a seal skin to take human form on land?
clue_et: Milline Šoti ja Iiri folklooriolend jätab hülgenaha maha, et maismaal inimese kuju võtta?
explanation_en: Selkie tales often turn on a hidden seal skin that the transformed being needs in order to return to the sea.
explanation_et: Selkie-lugudes on sageli keskne peidetud hülgenahk, mida moondunud olend vajab merre naasmiseks.

clue_en: Which female spirit in Irish folklore warns of a family death with a mournful cry?
clue_et: Milline Iiri folkloori naisvaim hoiatab leinalise häälitsusega perekonnas saabuvast surmast?
explanation_en: The banshee’s lament is traditionally heard as an omen that someone in a particular family will die.
explanation_et: Banshee itku peetakse pärimuses endeks, et kindlas perekonnas sureb keegi.

clue_en: What golden fossil resin found on Baltic beaches is often called the gold of the Baltic?
clue_et: Millist Läänemere randadelt leitavat kuldset fossiilset vaiku nimetatakse sageli Läänemere kullaks?
explanation_en: Amber from ancient tree resin has been collected and traded around the Baltic Sea for thousands of years.
explanation_et: Muistsest puuvaigust tekkinud merevaiku on Läänemere ääres kogutud ja kaubeldud tuhandeid aastaid.

clue_en: What mythical plant blossom do people seek on midsummer night in Baltic folklore?
clue_et: Millist müütilist taimeõit otsitakse Balti rahvapärimuses jaaniööl?
explanation_en: Ferns do not truly flower, but folklore promises luck or hidden treasure to the person who finds the magical blossom.
explanation_et: Sõnajalad tegelikult ei õitse, kuid pärimus lubab võluõie leidjale õnne või peidetud varandust.

clue_en: What Estonian word names a sacred natural grove traditionally used for worship?
clue_et: Milline eesti sõna tähistab looduslikku pühapaika või püha salu?
explanation_en: A hiis is a protected natural sacred place associated with communal rites and traditional belief.
explanation_et: Hiis on kaitstud looduslik pühapaik, mida seostatakse kogukondlike rituaalide ja pärimusliku usuga.

clue_en: Which Lithuanian underworld figure later blended with the Christian devil in folklore?
clue_et: Milline Leedu allilmategelane sulandus rahvapärimuses hiljem kristliku kuradiga?
explanation_en: Velnias has roots in pre-Christian Baltic belief and later appears as a devil-like folklore character.
explanation_et: Velnias pärineb kristluseelsest Balti usundist ning esineb hiljem kuraditaolise rahvajututegelasena.

clue_en: Which sea goddess in a Lithuanian legend lives in an amber palace and falls in love with the fisherman Kastytis?
clue_et: Milline merejumalanna elab Leedu muistendis merevaigulossis ja armub kalur Kastytisesse?
explanation_en: Perkūnas destroys Jūratė’s underwater palace after learning of her forbidden love, according to a familiar version of the legend.
explanation_et: Levinud muistendiversiooni järgi purustab Perkūnas Jūratė veealuse lossi, kui saab teada tema keelatud armastusest.

clue_en: Which giant hero gives Estonia’s national epic its title?
clue_et: Milline hiidkangelane annab Eesti rahvuseeposele pealkirja?
explanation_en: Kalevipoeg, the son of Kalev, is the central hero of the epic compiled by Friedrich Reinhold Kreutzwald.
explanation_et: Kalevipoeg ehk Kalevi poeg on Friedrich Reinhold Kreutzwaldi koostatud eepose keskne kangelane.

clue_en: Which clumsy devil-like figure is repeatedly outwitted in Estonian folk tales?
clue_et: Milline kohmakas kuraditaoline tegelane jääb Eesti rahvajuttudes korduvalt ninapidi veetuks?
explanation_en: Vanapagan often appears as a strong but foolish opponent whom a clever human can trick.
explanation_et: Vanapagan esineb sageli tugeva, kuid rumala vastasena, kelle kaval inimene üle kavaldab.

clue_en: Which servant made from household objects flies to steal wealth after its owner bargains for a soul?
clue_et: Milline kodustest esemetest valmistatud teenija lendab rikkust varastama pärast seda, kui omanik hinge peale kaupa teeb?
explanation_en: An Estonian kratt is animated through a pact with the devil and must be kept constantly at work.
explanation_et: Eesti kratt äratatakse ellu kuradiga sõlmitud lepingu kaudu ning talle tuleb pidevalt tööd anda.

clue_en: Which alluring Estonian water spirit may lure people into a lake or river?
clue_et: Milline ahvatlev Eesti veevaim võib inimesi järve või jõkke meelitada?
explanation_en: The näkk belongs to a northern European family of water spirits whose beauty or music conceals danger.
explanation_et: Näkk kuulub Põhja-Euroopa veevaimude hulka, kelle ilu või muusika varjab ohtu.

clue_en: Which giant hero of Saaremaa throws huge stones and fights enemies from across the sea?
clue_et: Milline Saaremaa hiidkangelane heidab suuri kive ja võitleb üle mere tulnud vaenlastega?
explanation_en: Saaremaa legends make Suur Tõll a mighty protector whose landscape-shaping deeds explain local boulders and places.
explanation_et: Saaremaa muistendites on Suur Tõll vägev kaitsja, kelle maastikku kujundavad teod seletavad kohalikke rahne ja paiku.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Finnish Kalevala
clue_en: Which wise old singer and kantele player is the central hero of the epic?
clue_et: Milline tark vana laulja ja kandlemängija on eepose keskne kangelane?
explanation_en: Väinämöinen’s songs possess magical power, and his journeys frame much of the Kalevala.
explanation_et: Väinämöise lauludel on võlujõud ning tema rännakud raamivad suurt osa „Kalevalast”.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Finnish Kalevala
clue_en: What mysterious prosperity-making object is forged and later fought over?
clue_et: Milline salapärane jõukust tootev ese sepistatakse ja muutub hiljem võitluse põhjuseks?
explanation_en: The Sampo is a magical device that brings wealth to Pohjola until the heroes try to take it.
explanation_et: Sampo on võluseade, mis toob Põhjalale rikkust, kuni kangelased püüavad selle ära võtta.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Finnish Kalevala
clue_en: Which powerful mistress rules the northern land of Pohjola and sets heroes difficult tasks?
clue_et: Milline võimas emand valitseb põhjapoolset Põhjalat ja seab kangelastele raskeid ülesandeid?
explanation_en: Louhi is Pohjola’s formidable ruler, magician and principal opponent of the Kalevala heroes.
explanation_et: Louhi on Põhjala võimas valitseja, nõid ja „Kalevala” kangelaste peamine vastane.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Finnish Kalevala
clue_en: Which eternal smith forges the Sampo?
clue_et: Milline igavene sepp sepistab Sampo?
explanation_en: Ilmarinen is the master smith whose greatest achievement is forging the magical Sampo.
explanation_et: Ilmarinen on meistersepp, kelle suurim saavutus on võlusampo sepistamine.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The Finnish Kalevala
clue_en: Which tragic youth grows up enslaved, seeks revenge and ultimately falls on his own sword?
clue_et: Milline traagiline noormees kasvab orjana, otsib kättemaksu ja langeb lõpuks oma mõõga otsa?
explanation_en: Kullervo’s cycle is one of the epic’s darkest stories, driven by abuse, revenge and disastrous recognition.
explanation_et: Kullervo-tsükkel on eepose üks süngemaid lugusid, mida kannavad väärkohtlemine, kättemaks ja hukatuslik äratundmine.

clue_en: Which first book of the Bible opens with God creating heaven and earth?
clue_et: Milline Piibli esimene raamat algab sellega, et Jumal loob taeva ja maa?
explanation_en: Genesis contains the biblical creation narratives and begins the Jewish Torah and Christian Old Testament.
explanation_et: Esimeses Moosese raamatus on piibellikud loomislood ning sellega algavad juudi Toora ja kristlik Vana Testament.

clue_en: In Hesiod’s Greek creation story, what primordial state or gap exists first?
clue_et: Milline algolek või tühimik eksisteerib Hesiodose Kreeka loomisloos esimesena?
explanation_en: Hesiod’s Theogony begins with Chaos, followed by powers including Gaia and Eros.
explanation_et: Hesiodose „Theogonia” algab Chaosest, millele järgnevad muu hulgas Gaia ja Eros.

clue_en: According to Norse myth, whose body becomes the earth, sea and sky after Odin and his brothers kill him?
clue_et: Kelle kehast saavad Põhjala müüdi järgi maa, meri ja taevas pärast seda, kui Odin ja ta vennad ta tapavad?
explanation_en: The gods shape the ordered world from the primordial giant Ymir’s flesh, blood, bones and skull.
explanation_et: Jumalad kujundavad ürghiiglase Ymiri lihast, verest, luudest ja koljust korrastatud maailma.

clue_en: In many Hindu traditions, which deity performs the role of creator within the Trimurti?
clue_et: Milline jumalus täidab paljudes hindu traditsioonides loojarolli Trimurti koosseisus?
explanation_en: Brahma is conventionally described as the creator, alongside Vishnu the preserver and Shiva the destroyer.
explanation_et: Brahmat kirjeldatakse tavaliselt loojana Višnu kui säilitaja ja Šiva kui hävitaja kõrval.

clue_en: Which familiar object appears as a cosmic container from which the world or its creator hatches in several creation myths?
clue_et: Milline tuttav ese esineb mitmes loomisloos kosmilise anumina, millest koorub maailm või selle looja?
explanation_en: World-egg myths imagine the cosmos, a creator or the first beings emerging when a primeval egg opens.
explanation_et: Maailmamuna müütides tekivad kosmos, looja või esimesed olendid ürgse muna avanemisel.

clue_en: Who builds an ark in the biblical flood narrative?
clue_et: Kes ehitab piibellikus veeuputusloos laeva?
explanation_en: Genesis says Noah builds the ark for his family and living creatures before the flood.
explanation_et: Esimese Moosese raamatu järgi ehitab Noa enne veeuputust laeva oma perele ja elusolenditele.

clue_en: What colourful sign appears after Noah’s flood as a symbol of God’s covenant with the earth?
clue_et: Milline värviline märk ilmub pärast Noa veeuputust Jumala ja maa lepingu sümbolina?
explanation_en: Genesis presents the rainbow in the clouds as the sign of the covenant after the flood.
explanation_et: Esimene Moosese raamat kujutab pilvedes vikerkaart veeuputusjärgse lepingu märgina.

clue_en: Which ancient Mesopotamian epic includes a survivor’s account of a boat, a great flood and birds sent to find land?
clue_et: Milline muistne Mesopotaamia eepos sisaldab pääsenu jutustust laevast, suurest veeuputusest ja maad otsima saadetud lindudest?
explanation_en: In the Epic of Gilgamesh, Utnapishtim tells Gilgamesh how he survived a divinely sent flood.
explanation_et: „Gilgameši eeposes” jutustab Utnapištim Gilgamešile, kuidas ta jumalate saadetud veeuputuse üle elas.

clue_en: Which familiar Greek god sends the flood survived by Deucalion and Pyrrha?
clue_et: Milline tuntud Kreeka jumal saadab veeuputuse, mille elavad üle Deukalion ja Pyrrha?
explanation_en: In the Greek flood myth, Zeus sends the deluge and Deucalion and Pyrrha survive in a chest.
explanation_et: Kreeka veeuputusmüüdis saadab Zeus uputuse ning Deukalion ja Pyrrha pääsevad kirstulaadses anumas.

clue_en: Which Hindu deity takes the fish form Matsya and warns Manu about a coming flood?
clue_et: Milline hindu jumalus võtab kala Matsya kuju ja hoiatab Manut saabuva veeuputuse eest?
explanation_en: Matsya is Vishnu’s fish avatar, who guides Manu’s boat to safety during the deluge.
explanation_et: Matsya on Višnu kala-avatar, kes juhib Manu paadi veeuputuse ajal ohutusse kohta.

clue_en: Which West African and Caribbean trickster often appears as a spider and wins through clever stories?
clue_et: Milline Lääne-Aafrika ja Kariibi trikster esineb sageli ämblikuna ning võidab kavalate lugude abil?
explanation_en: Anansi comes from Akan tradition and became a central folk character across the African diaspora.
explanation_et: Anansi pärineb akani pärimusest ja temast sai keskne rahvajututegelane kogu Aafrika diasporaas.

clue_en: Which talkative animal trickster shapes the world and causes trouble in many Indigenous North American traditions?
clue_et: Milline jutukas loomtrikster kujundab maailma ja põhjustab pahandusi paljudes Põhja-Ameerika põlisrahvaste pärimustes?
explanation_en: Coyote can be creator, culture hero, fool or deceiver depending on the particular nation and story.
explanation_et: Koiott võib olenevalt rahvast ja loost olla looja, kultuurikangelane, narr või petis.

clue_en: Which black bird steals or releases the sun, moon and stars in stories of several Pacific Northwest peoples?
clue_et: Milline must lind varastab või vabastab Vaikse ookeani looderanniku rahvaste lugudes päikese, kuu ja tähed?
explanation_en: Raven is a transformer and trickster in many Northwest Coast traditions, including tales about bringing light.
explanation_et: Kaaren on paljudes looderanniku pärimustes muundaja ja trikster, sealhulgas valguse toomise lugudes.

clue_en: Which Polynesian culture hero snares the sun so people have more daylight for their work?
clue_et: Milline Polüneesia kultuurikangelane püüab päikese kinni, et inimestel oleks tööks rohkem päevavalgust?
explanation_en: Versions across Polynesia credit Māui with slowing or controlling the sun’s rapid journey.
explanation_et: Polüneesia eri lugudes omistatakse Māuile päikese kiire teekonna aeglustamine või ohjeldamine.

clue_en: Which animal appears as the shapeshifting kitsune of Japanese folklore, sometimes playing tricks and sometimes acting as a guardian?
clue_et: Milline loom esineb Jaapani rahvapärimuse kujumuutja kitsune’na, kes vahel teeb vempe ja vahel tegutseb kaitsjana?
explanation_en: Kitsune are magical foxes in Japanese folklore whose stories range from mischievous deception to loyal protection.
explanation_et: Kitsune’d on Jaapani rahvapärimuse võlurebased, kelle lood ulatuvad vallatust pettusest ustava kaitsmiseni.

clue_en: What sacred vessel do Arthur’s knights seek in medieval romance?
clue_et: Millist püha anumat otsivad Arturi rüütlid keskaegsetes rüütliromaanides?
explanation_en: Grail romances turn the search for the mysterious vessel into a test of spiritual and knightly worth.
explanation_et: Graaliromaanid muudavad salapärase anuma otsingu vaimse ja rüütelliku väärikuse prooviks.

clue_en: Which leader of the Argonauts sails to Colchis for the Golden Fleece?
clue_et: Milline argonautide juht purjetab Kolchisesse kuldvillaku järele?
explanation_en: Jason commands the Argo and wins the Golden Fleece with crucial help from Medea.
explanation_et: Iason juhib Argot ja võidab kuldvillaku Medeia otsustava abiga.

clue_en: Which Mesopotamian king journeys in search of immortality after the death of Enkidu?
clue_et: Milline Mesopotaamia kuningas asub pärast Enkidu surma surematust otsima?
explanation_en: Gilgamesh reaches Utnapishtim but learns that permanent human immortality is beyond his grasp.
explanation_et: Gilgameš jõuab Utnapištimini, kuid õpib, et püsiv inimlik surematus jääb talle kättesaamatuks.

clue_en: Which Chinese novel sends the monk Tang Sanzang and the Monkey King westward to obtain Buddhist scriptures?
clue_et: Milline Hiina romaan saadab munk Tang Sanzangi ja Ahvikuninga läände budistlikke pühakirju tooma?
explanation_en: The pilgrims face monsters and trials on a legendary version of the historical journey to India.
explanation_et: Palverändurid kohtavad ajaloolise India-teekonna legendaarses versioonis koletisi ja katsumusi.

clue_en: What legendary golden city or kingdom did many European explorers seek in South America?
clue_et: Millist legendaarset kuldset linna või kuningriiki otsisid paljud Euroopa maadeavastajad Lõuna-Ameerikast?
explanation_en: The story began with a gilded ruler and grew into a legend of a fabulously rich lost city.
explanation_et: Lugu sai alguse kullatud valitsejast ja kasvas legendiks muinasjutuliselt rikkast kadunud linnast.

clue_en: Which container releases the world’s troubles when curiosity leads it to be opened?
clue_et: Millisest anumast pääsevad maailma hädad välja, kui uudishimu viib selle avamiseni?
explanation_en: The earliest Greek text describes a jar; “Pandora’s box” became the familiar later expression.
explanation_et: Varaseim Kreeka tekst kirjeldab suurt anumat; „Pandora laegas” sai tuttavaks hilisemaks väljendiks.

clue_en: Which legendary sword is returned to the Lady of the Lake after Arthur’s final battle?
clue_et: Milline legendaarne mõõk tagastatakse pärast Arthuri viimast lahingut Järvedaamile?
explanation_en: In a familiar ending of Arthurian legend, a surviving knight casts Excalibur back into the lake.
explanation_et: Arturi-legendide tuttavas lõpus viskab ellujäänud rüütel Excaliburi tagasi järve.

clue_en: Which weapon’s name means Thor’s hammer and is said to return after being thrown?
clue_et: Milline relv on Thori vasar ja naaseb pärimuse järgi pärast heitmist?
explanation_en: Mjölnir is Thor’s supernatural hammer, used against giants and carried as a protective symbol.
explanation_et: Mjölnir on Thori üleloomulik vasar, mida kasutatakse hiiglaste vastu ja kantakse kaitsesümbolina.

clue_en: Which legendary alchemical substance could supposedly turn base metals into gold?
clue_et: Milline legendaarne alkeemiline aine pidi väidetavalt muutma lihtmetallid kullaks?
explanation_en: Alchemy credited the philosopher’s stone with transmutation and sometimes with producing an elixir of life.
explanation_et: Alkeemias omistati tarkade kivile metallide muundamise ja vahel ka elueliksiiri valmistamise võime.

clue_en: Which spear belonging to Odin has a name commonly interpreted as “the swaying one”?
clue_et: Milline Odinile kuuluv oda kannab nime, mida tõlgendatakse tavaliselt „võnkujana”?
explanation_en: Gungnir is Odin’s spear; its Old Norse name is commonly interpreted as “the swaying one”.
explanation_et: Gungnir on Odini oda ning selle vanapõhja nime tõlgendatakse tavaliselt „võnkujana”.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Dragons in Legend
clue_en: Which saint is traditionally shown on horseback rescuing a princess by killing a dragon?
clue_et: Millist pühakut kujutatakse traditsiooniliselt ratsul printsessi päästmas ja lohet tapmas?
explanation_en: The medieval legend of Saint George and the Dragon became a major image of heroic Christian knighthood.
explanation_et: Keskaegsest püha Jüri ja lohe legendist sai kristliku rüütlikangelaslikkuse tähtis kujund.
source_title: Saint George and the Dragon — Wikipedia

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Dragons in Legend
clue_en: Which dragon occupies the treasure of the Lonely Mountain in The Hobbit?
clue_et: Milline lohe hõivab „Kääbikus” Üksildase Mäe aarde?
explanation_en: Smaug drives the dwarves from Erebor and guards their hoard until Bilbo’s company arrives.
explanation_et: Smaug ajab päkapikud Ereborist välja ja valvab nende aaret, kuni saabub Bilbo seltskond.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Dragons in Legend
clue_en: Which figure in Germanic legend becomes a dragon to guard cursed gold and is slain by Sigurd?
clue_et: Milline germaani legendi tegelane muutub neetud kulla valvamiseks loheks ja langeb Sigurdi käe läbi?
explanation_en: Fafnir’s greed transforms him into a dragon, and Sigurd kills him from a pit beneath his path.
explanation_et: Ahnus muudab Fafniri loheks ning Sigurd tapab ta tema raja alla kaevatud august.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Dragons in Legend
clue_en: Which long, wingless-looking legendary creature is associated with rain and imperial power in China?
clue_et: Millist pikka, näiliselt tiivutut legendiolendit seostatakse Hiinas vihma ja keiserliku võimuga?
explanation_en: Chinese dragons are generally auspicious beings connected with water, weather and authority.
explanation_et: Hiina lohed on enamasti soodsad olendid, keda seostatakse vee, ilma ja võimuga.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Dragons in Legend
clue_en: Which country places the legendary red dragon Y Ddraig Goch on its national flag?
clue_et: Millise riigi lipul on legendaarne punane lohe Y Ddraig Goch?
explanation_en: The flag of Wales shows Y Ddraig Goch, the red dragon long associated with Welsh tradition.
explanation_et: Walesi lipul on Y Ddraig Goch, punane lohe, mida seostatakse kaua Walesi pärimusega.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Giants in Myth
clue_en: Which Philistine giant is defeated by the young David with a sling?
clue_et: Millise vilistist hiiglase alistab noor Taavet linguga?
explanation_en: The biblical story contrasts the heavily armed Goliath with David’s sling and trust in God.
explanation_et: Piiblilugu vastandab raskelt relvastatud Koljatit Taaveti lingu ja usaldusega Jumala vastu.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Giants in Myth
clue_en: Which giant lumberjack of North American tall tales travels with Babe the Blue Ox?
clue_et: Milline Põhja-Ameerika pajatuslugude hiiglaslik metsatööline rändab koos sinise härja Babe’iga?
explanation_en: Paul Bunyan is a gigantic lumberjack hero whose exaggerated adventures reshape the landscape.
explanation_et: Paul Bunyan on hiiglaslik metsatöölisest kangelane, kelle liialdatud seiklused muudavad maastikku.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Giants in Myth
clue_en: What collective name is used for the giant beings who frequently oppose and marry into the Norse gods?
clue_et: Millise koondnimetusega tuntakse hiidolendeid, kes Põhjala jumalatega sageli võitlevad ja ka abielluvad?
explanation_en: The jötnar are a diverse mythic group, not simply oversized monsters, and many gods have jötunn ancestry.
explanation_et: Jötunid on mitmekesine müütiline rühm, mitte lihtsalt ülekasvanud koletised, ning paljudel jumalatel on jötuni esivanemaid.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Giants in Myth
clue_en: Which Irish hero is said in folklore to have built the Giant’s Causeway toward Scotland?
clue_et: Milline Iiri kangelane olevat rahvapärimuse järgi ehitanud Hiiglaste tee Šotimaa suunas?
explanation_en: A later popular legend explains the basalt columns as a causeway made by Fionn to meet a Scottish rival.
explanation_et: Hilisem populaarne legend seletab basaltsambaid teena, mille Fionn ehitas Šoti vastasega kohtumiseks.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Giants in Myth
clue_en: Which famous English stone circle did Geoffrey of Monmouth claim Merlin moved from a monument built by giants in Ireland?
clue_et: Millise kuulsa Inglismaa kiviringi olevat Geoffrey Monmouthist väitel Merlin toonud Iirimaalt hiiglaste rajatud monumendist?
explanation_en: Geoffrey of Monmouth linked Stonehenge to the Giant’s Dance in Ireland and said Merlin transported its stones.
explanation_et: Geoffrey Monmouthist sidus Stonehenge’i Iirimaa Hiiglaste tantsuga ja kirjutas, et Merlin vedas selle kivid ära.

clue_en: What name is shared by the Greek realm of the dead and its ruler?
clue_et: Millist nime kannavad nii Kreeka surnuteriik kui ka selle valitseja?
explanation_en: In Greek tradition, Hades can mean the god and the underworld kingdom over which he rules.
explanation_et: Kreeka pärimuses võib Hades tähendada nii jumalat kui ka allilmariiki, mida ta valitseb.

clue_en: Which Norse realm receives many of those who die of sickness or old age and shares its name with its ruler?
clue_et: Milline Põhjala riik võtab vastu paljud haiguse või vanaduse tõttu surnud ja jagab nime oma valitsejannaga?
explanation_en: Hel is both a female being and the realm assigned to her, distinct from the warriors’ Valhalla.
explanation_et: Hel on nii naisolevus kui ka talle määratud riik, mis erineb sõdalaste Valhallast.

clue_en: Through which Egyptian realm does the sun god travel at night while the dead face gates and judgement?
clue_et: Millise Egiptuse riigi läbib päikesejumal öösel, samal ajal kui surnud kohtavad väravaid ja kohtumõistmist?
explanation_en: The Duat is the Egyptian otherworld mapped in funerary texts as a place of nightly renewal and peril.
explanation_et: Duat on Egiptuse teispoolsus, mida matusekirjandus kaardistab öise uuenemise ja ohtude paigana.

clue_en: Which Maya underworld do the Hero Twins challenge in the Popol Vuh?
clue_et: Millise maajade allilma isandatele esitavad kangelaskaksikud „Popol Vuhis” väljakutse?
explanation_en: The Popol Vuh portrays Xibalba as a dangerous realm of trials ruled by death lords.
explanation_et: „Popol Vuh” kujutab Xibalbat surmaisandate valitsetud ohtliku katsumuste riigina.

clue_en: The shadowy land of the dead called Yomi belongs to the mythology of which country?
clue_et: Millise riigi mütoloogias asub sünge surnuteriik nimega Yomi?
explanation_en: Yomi is the land of the dead in Japanese mythology, entered by Izanagi while seeking Izanami.
explanation_et: Yomi on Jaapani mütoloogia surnuteriik, kuhu Izanagi läheb Izanamit otsima.

clue_en: Which Greek mountain is the mythological home of Zeus and the other Olympians?
clue_et: Milline Kreeka mägi on mütoloogiline Zeusi ja teiste olümposlaste kodu?
explanation_en: Greece’s tallest mountain became imagined as the divine seat of the Olympian gods.
explanation_et: Kreeka kõrgeimat mäge kujutleti Olümpose jumalate jumaliku asupaigana.

clue_en: On which mountain does biblical tradition say Moses received the Ten Commandments?
clue_et: Millisel mäel sai Mooses piiblipärimuse järgi kümme käsku?
explanation_en: Exodus places the covenant and giving of the commandments at Mount Sinai.
explanation_et: Teine Moosese raamat paigutab lepingu sõlmimise ja käskude andmise Siinai mäele.

clue_en: Which snow-capped Japanese volcano has long been a destination for pilgrimage and artistic devotion?
clue_et: Milline lumise tipuga Jaapani vulkaan on kaua olnud palverännaku ja kunstilise austuse sihtkoht?
explanation_en: Fuji is sacred in Shinto and Buddhist traditions and has inspired pilgrimage routes and countless images.
explanation_et: Fuji on püha šintoistlikus ja budistlikus pärimuses ning on inspireerinud palverännuteid ja lugematuid kujutisi.

clue_en: Which Tibetan peak is sacred to Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism and Bon and is circled by pilgrims?
clue_et: Milline Tiibeti tipp on püha hinduismis, budismis, džainismis ja böni usundis ning mida palverändurid ümber käivad?
explanation_en: Pilgrims perform a ritual circuit around Kailash, while climbing the mountain itself is discouraged.
explanation_et: Palverändurid teevad ümber Kailaši rituaalse ringi, mäe enda otsa ronimist aga taunitakse.

clue_en: Which great red sandstone monolith is sacred to the Aṉangu people of central Australia?
clue_et: Milline suur punasest liivakivist monoliit on Kesk-Austraalia Aṉangu rahvale püha?
explanation_en: Uluru is a living cultural landscape whose features carry Aṉangu law, stories and ceremonial meaning.
explanation_et: Uluru on elav kultuurmaastik, mille paikades on Aṉangu seadus, lood ja tseremoniaalne tähendus.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The World's Major Religions
clue_en: Which world religion centres on the life and teachings of Jesus?
clue_et: Milline maailmareligioon keskendub Jeesuse elule ja õpetustele?
explanation_en: Christians understand Jesus as the Christ, and communities formed around his teachings in the first century.
explanation_et: Kristlased mõistavad Jeesust Kristusena ning tema õpetuste ümber kujunesid esimesel sajandil kogudused.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The World's Major Religions
clue_en: Which religion regards Muhammad as the final prophet in a line that includes Abraham, Moses and Jesus?
clue_et: Milline religioon peab Muhammadi viimaseks prohvetiks reas, kuhu kuuluvad Aabraham, Mooses ja Jeesus?
explanation_en: Muslims regard Muhammad as God’s final messenger while also honouring earlier Abrahamic prophets.
explanation_et: Moslemid peavad Muhammadi Jumala viimaseks sõnumitoojaks ja austavad ka varasemaid Aabrahami traditsiooni prohveteid.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The World's Major Religions
clue_en: Which diverse family of traditions originating in India includes ideas such as dharma, karma and rebirth?
clue_et: Milline Indiast pärinev mitmekesine traditsioonide pere hõlmab dharma, karma ja taassünni mõisteid?
explanation_en: Hinduism has no single founder and encompasses many philosophies, forms of worship and deities.
explanation_et: Hinduismil pole üht rajajat ning see hõlmab paljusid filosoofiaid, jumalateenistusviise ja jumalusi.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The World's Major Religions
clue_en: Which tradition founded in South Asia follows teachings attributed to the Buddha about awakening and suffering?
clue_et: Milline Lõuna-Aasias tekkinud traditsioon järgib Buddhale omistatud õpetusi virgumisest ja kannatusest?
explanation_en: Buddhist traditions trace their teachings to Siddhartha Gautama, known after awakening as the Buddha.
explanation_et: Budistlikud traditsioonid lähtuvad Siddhartha Gautama õpetustest; pärast virgumist tunti teda Buddhana.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: The World's Major Religions
clue_en: Which ancient monotheistic tradition of the Jewish people is rooted in the covenant and the Torah?
clue_et: Milline juudi rahva muistne monoteistlik traditsioon põhineb lepingul ja Tooral?
explanation_en: Judaism developed around the relationship between God and Israel expressed in the Hebrew Bible and later tradition.
explanation_et: Judaism kujunes Jumala ja Iisraeli suhte ümber, mida väljendavad heebrea Piibel ja hilisem pärimus.

clue_en: Whose life, death and resurrection stand at the centre of Christian belief?
clue_et: Kelle elu, surm ja ülestõusmine on kristliku usu keskmes?
explanation_en: Christian teaching identifies Jesus of Nazareth as the Christ and Son of God.
explanation_et: Kristlik õpetus samastab Naatsareti Jeesuse Kristuse ja Jumala Pojaga.

clue_en: Which shape became the main Christian symbol because it recalls the crucifixion?
clue_et: Milline kujund sai peamiseks kristlikuks sümboliks, sest meenutab ristilöömist?
explanation_en: The cross recalls Jesus’s crucifixion and, for Christians, the salvation associated with it.
explanation_et: Rist meenutab Jeesuse ristilöömist ja kristlastele sellega seotud päästet.

clue_en: Which rite uses water to mark entry into the Christian community?
clue_et: Milline talitus kasutab vett kristlikku kogukonda astumise tähistamiseks?
explanation_en: Christian baptism uses immersion or pouring or sprinkling of water as a rite of initiation.
explanation_et: Kristlik ristimine kasutab sissekastmist, vee valamist või piserdamist vastuvõtutalitusena.

clue_en: Which Christian rite shares bread and wine in memory of the Last Supper?
clue_et: Millises kristlikus talituses jagatakse viimse õhtusöömaaja mälestuseks leiba ja veini?
explanation_en: Christian traditions celebrate the Eucharist in different ways while recalling Jesus’s meal with his disciples.
explanation_et: Kristlikud traditsioonid pühitsevad armulauda eri viisidel, meenutades Jeesuse söömaaega jüngritega.

clue_en: What doctrine describes one God as Father, Son and Holy Spirit in most Christian traditions?
clue_et: Milline õpetus kirjeldab enamikus kristlikes traditsioonides üht Jumalat Isa, Poja ja Püha Vaimuna?
explanation_en: Trinitarian Christianity teaches that the three persons are distinct yet share one divine being.
explanation_et: Kolmainsuslik kristlus õpetab, et kolm isikut on erinevad, kuid jagavad üht jumalikku olemust.

clue_en: What name is given to the first five books of the Hebrew Bible and their handwritten synagogue scroll?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse heebrea Piibli viit esimest raamatut ja nende käsitsi kirjutatud sünagoogirulli?
explanation_en: The Torah is Judaism’s foundational written teaching and is read publicly from a scroll.
explanation_et: Toora on judaismi alusõpetus ning seda loetakse avalikult kirjarullilt.

clue_en: What title is used for a Jewish religious teacher and scholar?
clue_et: Millist tiitlit kannab juudi usuõpetaja ja õpetlane?
explanation_en: A rabbi is trained in Jewish law and tradition and may lead teaching, worship and community life.
explanation_et: Rabi on õppinud juudi seadust ja pärimust ning võib juhtida õpetamist, jumalateenistust ja kogukonnaelu.

clue_en: Which weekly day of rest begins at sunset on Friday?
clue_et: Milline iganädalane puhkepäev algab reedel päikeseloojangul?
explanation_en: Jewish Shabbat lasts from Friday evening until Saturday evening and is marked by rest, prayer and meals.
explanation_et: Juudi šabat kestab reede õhtust laupäeva õhtuni ning seda tähistavad puhkus, palve ja ühised söögid.

clue_en: Which branched lampstand became one of the oldest symbols of Judaism?
clue_et: Millisest harulisest lambijalast sai üks judaismi vanimaid sümboleid?
explanation_en: The seven-branched Temple menorah is distinct from the nine-branched lamp used at Hanukkah.
explanation_et: Templi seitsmeharuline menoraa erineb hanuka ajal kasutatavast üheksaharulisest lambist.

clue_en: What Hebrew term names the whole body of Jewish dietary law?
clue_et: Milline heebrea termin tähistab juudi toiduseaduste tervikkogu?
explanation_en: Kashrut is the system of Jewish dietary rules, while food permitted by those rules is described as kosher.
explanation_et: Kašrut on juudi toidureeglite süsteem, nende reeglite järgi lubatud toitu nimetatakse koššeriks.

clue_en: What is the central sacred scripture of Islam called?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse islami keskset pühakirja?
explanation_en: Muslims regard the Quran as revelation from God delivered in Arabic to Muhammad.
explanation_et: Moslemid peavad Koraani Jumala ilmutuseks, mis anti Muhammadile araabia keeles.

clue_en: During which lunar month do Muslims fast from dawn to sunset?
clue_et: Millise kuukalendri kuu ajal paastuvad moslemid koidust päikeseloojanguni?
explanation_en: Fasting during Ramadan is one of Islam’s Five Pillars, with exemptions recognised for particular circumstances.
explanation_et: Ramadaaniaegne paast on üks islami viiest sambast ning teatud olukordades on ette nähtud erandid.

clue_en: Which Saudi Arabian city contains the Kaaba and is the destination of the hajj?
clue_et: Millises Saudi Araabia linnas asub Kaaba ja kuhu suundub hadž?
explanation_en: Mecca is Islam’s holiest city; Muslims face toward the Kaaba there during ritual prayer.
explanation_et: Meka on islami pühaim linn; moslemid pöörduvad rituaalses palves sealse Kaaba poole.

clue_en: What pilgrimage to Mecca is required once in a lifetime for Muslims who are able to make it?
clue_et: Milline palverännak Mekasse on võimekale moslemile kord elus kohustuslik?
explanation_en: The hajj takes place in a set month and includes rites at the Kaaba, Arafat and other sites.
explanation_et: Hadž toimub kindlas kuus ning hõlmab talitusi Kaaba juures, Arafatil ja teistes paikades.

clue_en: Which Pillar of Islam requires giving a set share of eligible wealth for charitable purposes?
clue_et: Milline islami sammas nõuab kindla osa sobiva vara andmist heategevuseks?
explanation_en: Zakat is obligatory almsgiving intended to purify wealth and support specified groups in need.
explanation_et: Zakat on kohustuslik almus, mille eesmärk on vara puhastada ja toetada kindlaid abivajajate rühmi.

clue_en: What concept links intentional actions with consequences across lives in many Indian traditions?
clue_et: Milline mõiste seob paljudes India traditsioonides tahtlikud teod tagajärgedega üle elude?
explanation_en: Karma literally concerns action and describes how deeds help shape future experience and rebirth.
explanation_et: Karma tähendab algselt tegu ning kirjeldab, kuidas teod kujundavad tulevasi kogemusi ja taassündi.

clue_en: Which broad concept can mean duty, right conduct and the order that sustains life?
clue_et: Milline lai mõiste võib tähendada kohust, õiget käitumist ja elu kandvat korda?
explanation_en: In Hindu traditions, dharma varies with context but concerns conduct that upholds moral and cosmic order.
explanation_et: Hindu traditsioonides sõltub dharma kontekstist, kuid puudutab moraalset ja kosmilist korda hoidvat käitumist.

clue_en: What term in Hindu philosophy names the ultimate reality underlying existence?
clue_et: Milline hindu filosoofia termin tähistab olemise aluseks olevat ülimat reaalsust?
explanation_en: Brahman is the supreme universal principle in major Hindu philosophical traditions and is not the same word as Brahma the creator deity.
explanation_et: Brahman on tähtsates hindu filosoofiatraditsioonides kõrgeim universaalne printsiip ega ole sama mis loojajumal Brahma.

clue_en: Which cycle of death and rebirth do Indian traditions call saṃsāra?
clue_et: Millist surma ja taassünni ringkäiku nimetavad India traditsioonid saṃsāra’ks?
explanation_en: Samsara is the continuing cycle of conditioned existence from which liberation is sought.
explanation_et: Sansaar on tingitud olemise jätkuv ringkäik, millest otsitakse vabanemist.

clue_en: What name is given to liberation from the cycle of rebirth in Hindu thought?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse hindu mõtlemises vabanemist taassünni ringkäigust?
explanation_en: Moksha is spiritual release from samsara and is one of the major aims of human life in Hindu traditions.
explanation_et: Mokša on vaimne vabanemine sansaarast ning hindu traditsioonides üks inimelu peamisi eesmärke.

clue_en: What title meaning “awakened one” was given to Siddhartha Gautama?
clue_et: Milline „virgunut” tähendav tiitel anti Siddhartha Gautamale?
explanation_en: Buddha is a title for one who has awakened; Siddhartha Gautama is the historical teacher at Buddhism’s origin.
explanation_et: Buddha on virgunu tiitel; Siddhartha Gautama on budismi alguse ajalooline õpetaja.

clue_en: Which four-part teaching diagnoses suffering, its cause, its ending and the path?
clue_et: Milline neljaosaline õpetus käsitleb kannatust, selle põhjust, lõppemist ja teed?
explanation_en: The Four Noble Truths provide a basic framework for understanding the Buddhist path.
explanation_et: Neli õilsat tõde annavad budistliku tee mõistmiseks põhiraamistiku.

clue_en: What term describes release from craving, suffering and the cycle of rebirth?
clue_et: Milline termin kirjeldab vabanemist ihast, kannatusest ja taassünni ringkäigust?
explanation_en: Nirvana is the Buddhist goal in which the causes binding beings to suffering and rebirth are extinguished.
explanation_et: Nirvaana on budistlik eesmärk, kus kannatuse ja taassünniga siduvad põhjused kustuvad.

clue_en: Which practice trains attention and insight through methods such as mindfulness?
clue_et: Milline praktika treenib tähelepanu ja mõistmist näiteks teadveloleku abil?
explanation_en: Buddhist meditation includes varied practices for calm, concentration, mindfulness and insight.
explanation_et: Budistlik meditatsioon hõlmab mitmesuguseid rahu, keskendumise, teadveloleku ja mõistmise harjutusi.

clue_en: Which path groups right view, intention, speech, action, livelihood, effort, mindfulness and concentration?
clue_et: Milline tee ühendab õige vaate, kavatsuse, kõne, teo, eluviisi, pingutuse, teadveloleku ja keskendumise?
explanation_en: The Noble Eightfold Path is the practical fourth Noble Truth leading toward the end of suffering.
explanation_et: Õilis kaheksaosaline tee on praktiline neljas õilis tõde, mis juhib kannatuse lõppemise poole.

clue_en: Which teacher founded the Sikh tradition in Punjab?
clue_et: Milline õpetaja rajas Pandžabis sikhi traditsiooni?
explanation_en: Guru Nanak taught devotion to one God, honest work, sharing and the equality of people.
explanation_et: Guru Nanak õpetas pühendumist ühele Jumalale, ausat tööd, jagamist ja inimeste võrdsust.

clue_en: Which scripture is revered by Sikhs as the eternal living Guru?
clue_et: Millist pühakirja austavad sikhid igavese elava Guruna?
explanation_en: The Guru Granth Sahib contains hymns by Sikh Gurus and other devotional poets and holds final spiritual authority.
explanation_et: Guru Granth Sahib sisaldab sikhi gurude ja teiste pühendusluuletajate hümne ning kannab kõrgeimat vaimset autoriteeti.

clue_en: What collective name is given to kesh, kangha, kara, kachera and kirpan?
clue_et: Millise koondnimega tuntakse kesh’i, kangha’t, kara’t, kachera’t ja kirpan’it?
explanation_en: The Five Ks are articles of faith worn by initiated Khalsa Sikhs as signs of commitment and identity.
explanation_et: Viis K-d on Khalsa liikmeks pühitsetud sikhide usuartiklid, mis väljendavad pühendumist ja identiteeti.

clue_en: What initiated Sikh community was founded by Guru Gobind Singh?
clue_et: Millise pühitsetud sikhi kogukonna rajas Guru Gobind Singh?
explanation_en: The Khalsa established a shared discipline and identity for initiated Sikhs under Guru Gobind Singh in 1699.
explanation_et: Khalsa kehtestas Guru Gobind Singhi juhtimisel 1699. aastal pühitsetud sikhide ühise korra ja identiteedi.

clue_en: What familiar English name is used for the Sikh holy site Harmandir Sahib in Amritsar?
clue_et: Millise tuttava ingliskeelse nimega tuntakse Amritsaris asuvat sikhide pühamut Harmandir Sahibi?
explanation_en: The Golden Temple is the common English name of the Harmandir Sahib, Sikhism’s foremost pilgrimage site.
explanation_et: Kuldne Tempel on Harmandir Sahibi, sikhismi tähtsaima palverännupaiga levinud ingliskeelne nimi.

clue_en: Which Christian festival celebrates the birth of Jesus?
clue_et: Milline kristlik püha tähistab Jeesuse sündi?
explanation_en: Christmas commemorates the Nativity of Jesus and is celebrated by most Christians in December or January.
explanation_et: Jõulud tähistavad Jeesuse sündi ning enamik kristlasi peab neid detsembris või jaanuaris.

clue_en: Which Muslim festival marks the end of the Ramadan fast?
clue_et: Milline moslemite püha tähistab ramadaanipaastu lõppu?
explanation_en: Eid al-Fitr begins when Ramadan ends and is marked by prayer, charity, visits and festive meals.
explanation_et: ʿĪd al-Fiṭr algab ramadaani lõppedes ning seda tähistavad palve, heategevus, külaskäigud ja pidusöögid.

clue_en: Which Hindu, Jain and Sikh festival is widely known as the Festival of Lights?
clue_et: Millist hindu, džaini ja sikhi püha tuntakse laialt valgusfestivalina?
explanation_en: Diwali traditions vary by community but commonly feature lamps, family gatherings and celebration of light over darkness.
explanation_et: Diwali kombed erinevad kogukonniti, kuid sageli süüdatakse lampe, kogunetakse perega ja tähistatakse valguse võitu pimeduse üle.

clue_en: Which eight-night Jewish festival uses a special nine-branched lamp?
clue_et: Millisel kaheksaöisel juudi pühal kasutatakse erilist üheksaharulist lampi?
explanation_en: Hanukkah recalls the rededication of the Jerusalem Temple; a new light is kindled on each night.
explanation_et: Hanuka meenutab Jeruusalemma templi taaspühitsemist ning igal õhtul süüdatakse uus tuli.

clue_en: Which Buddhist festival commemorates the Buddha’s birth, awakening and passing away in many traditions?
clue_et: Milline budistlik püha mälestab paljudes traditsioonides Buddha sündi, virgumist ja lahkumist?
explanation_en: Vesak is the major annual Buddhist observance of key events in Gautama Buddha’s life.
explanation_et: Vesak on suur iga-aastane budistlik püha Gautama Buddha elu põhisündmuste mälestamiseks.

clue_en: Which scripture is divided by Christians into the Old and New Testaments?
clue_et: Millise pühakirja jagavad kristlased Vanaks ja Uueks Testamendiks?
explanation_en: The Christian Bible joins the books of the Old Testament with the specifically Christian New Testament.
explanation_et: Kristlik Piibel ühendab Vana Testamendi raamatud kristluse Uue Testamendiga.

clue_en: Which scripture is recited in Arabic and arranged into chapters called surahs?
clue_et: Millist pühakirja retsiteeritakse araabia keeles ja mis on jaotatud suuradeks?
explanation_en: The Quran’s Arabic text is organised into 114 surahs of different lengths.
explanation_et: Koraani araabiakeelne tekst on jagatud 114 erineva pikkusega suuraks.

clue_en: Which major Jewish text consists of the Mishnah together with the Gemara’s rabbinic analysis and debate?
clue_et: Milline tähtis juudi tekst koosneb Mišnast ning Gemara rabiinlikust analüüsist ja arutelust?
explanation_en: The Talmud combines the Mishnah with the Gemara’s extensive rabbinic analysis and debate.
explanation_et: Talmud ühendab Mišna Gemara ulatusliku rabiinliku analüüsi ja aruteluga.

clue_en: What collective name is given to the ancient Sanskrit scriptures beginning with the Rigveda?
clue_et: Millise koondnimega tuntakse muistseid sanskritikeelseid pühakirju, mille hulka kuulub Rigveda?
explanation_en: The four Vedas are foundational śruti texts of Hindu tradition, with the Rigveda the oldest collection.
explanation_et: Neli veedat on hindu traditsiooni aluslikud śruti-tekstid ning Rigveda on vanim kogumik.

clue_en: Which sacred text, first published by Joseph Smith in 1830, is central to the Latter Day Saint movement?
clue_et: Milline 1830. aastal Joseph Smithi avaldatud püha tekst on Viimse Aja Pühade liikumise keskne pühakiri?
explanation_en: The Book of Mormon is a foundational sacred text of the Latter Day Saint movement.
explanation_et: Mormoni Raamat on Viimse Aja Pühade liikumise aluslik püha tekst.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Places of Worship
clue_en: What is the usual English word for a building where Christians gather for worship?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse tavaliselt hoonet, kuhu kristlased kogunevad jumalateenistusele?
explanation_en: A church building provides space for Christian public worship and community rites.
explanation_et: Kirikuhoone annab ruumi kristlikuks avalikuks jumalateenistuseks ja kogukondlikeks talitusteks.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Places of Worship
clue_en: What is a Muslim place of communal prayer called?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse moslemite ühispalvuse paika?
explanation_en: A mosque is a place of Islamic prayer; congregational Friday prayer is a central weekly gathering.
explanation_et: Mošee on islami palvepaik; reedene ühispalvus on keskne iganädalane kogunemine.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Places of Worship
clue_en: What Jewish house of prayer, study and assembly may also be called a shul?
clue_et: Millist juudi palve-, õppe- ja kogunemiskoda võidakse nimetada ka shul’iks?
explanation_en: Synagogues centre communal prayer and Torah reading and often provide space for study.
explanation_et: Sünagoogides on kesksel kohal ühispalve ja Toora lugemine ning sageli ka õppimine.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Places of Worship
clue_en: What Sanskrit-derived word is commonly used for a Hindu temple?
clue_et: Millist sanskriti päritolu sõna kasutatakse sageli hindu templi kohta?
explanation_en: A mandir houses sacred images and provides a space for pūjā and other Hindu rites.
explanation_et: Mandir sisaldab pühakujusid ning annab ruumi pūjā’ks ja teisteks hindu talitusteks.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Places of Worship
clue_en: Which plain two-word name is commonly used for a building where Quakers gather for worship?
clue_et: Millise lihtsa kahesõnalise nimega kutsutakse tavaliselt hoonet, kuhu kveekerid kogunevad jumalateenistuseks?
explanation_en: Quakers, formally the Religious Society of Friends, commonly call their places of worship meeting houses.
explanation_et: Kveekerid ehk Sõprade Usuline Ühing nimetavad oma jumalateenistuspaiku tavaliselt kogunemismajadeks.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Philosophers of the Ancient World
clue_en: Which Athenian philosopher is famous for probing conversations and wrote no philosophical books himself?
clue_et: Milline Ateena filosoof on kuulus uurivate vestluste poolest ega kirjutanud ise filosoofilisi raamatuid?
explanation_en: Our knowledge of Socrates comes mainly through other writers, especially dialogues by his student Plato.
explanation_et: Meie teadmised Sokratesest pärinevad peamiselt teistelt autoritelt, eriti tema õpilase Platoni dialoogidest.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Philosophers of the Ancient World
clue_en: Which student of Socrates founded the Academy in Athens?
clue_et: Milline Sokratese õpilane rajas Ateenas Akadeemia?
explanation_en: Plato’s Academy became one of the ancient world’s most influential centres of philosophical study.
explanation_et: Platoni Akadeemiast sai antiikmaailma üks mõjukamaid filosoofia õppekeskusi.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Philosophers of the Ancient World
clue_en: Which student of Plato taught Alexander the Great and founded the Lyceum?
clue_et: Milline Platoni õpilane õpetas Aleksander Suurt ja rajas Lykeioni?
explanation_en: Aristotle’s surviving works range across logic, ethics, politics, biology, poetics and metaphysics.
explanation_et: Aristotelese säilinud teosed käsitlevad loogikat, eetikat, poliitikat, bioloogiat, poeetikat ja metafüüsikat.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Philosophers of the Ancient World
clue_en: Which Chinese teacher emphasised cultivated character, ritual and right relationships in society?
clue_et: Milline Hiina õpetaja rõhutas haritud iseloomu, rituaali ja õigeid suhteid ühiskonnas?
explanation_en: Confucius’s teachings on humane conduct and social roles shaped East Asian thought for centuries.
explanation_et: Konfutsiuse õpetused inimlikust käitumisest ja ühiskondlikest rollidest kujundasid sajandeid Ida-Aasia mõtlemist.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Philosophers of the Ancient World
clue_en: Which Cynic philosopher reportedly lived in a large jar and challenged social convention with extreme simplicity?
clue_et: Milline küünikust filosoof elas pärimuse järgi suures anumas ja vaidlustas äärmise lihtsusega ühiskondlikke tavasid?
explanation_en: Stories about Diogenes use provocative acts and radical self-sufficiency to express Cynic philosophy.
explanation_et: Lood Diogenesest kasutavad küünikute filosoofia väljendamiseks provokatiivseid tegusid ja radikaalset iseseisvust.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Ideas in Ethics
clue_en: What principle says to treat other people as you would want them to treat you?
clue_et: Milline põhimõte ütleb, et teisi tuleb kohelda nii, nagu tahad, et sind koheldaks?
explanation_en: Versions of the Golden Rule appear in many religious and philosophical traditions as a standard of reciprocity.
explanation_et: Kuldreegli variante leidub paljudes usulistes ja filosoofilistes traditsioonides vastastikkuse mõõdupuuna.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Ideas in Ethics
clue_en: What term describes concern for another person’s wellbeing for their sake rather than one’s own gain?
clue_et: Milline termin kirjeldab hoolt teise inimese heaolu eest tema enda, mitte isikliku kasu nimel?
explanation_en: Altruism contrasts with egoism by treating another’s good as a reason for action in itself.
explanation_et: Altruism vastandub egoismile, pidades teise hüve iseenesest tegutsemise põhjuseks.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Ideas in Ethics
clue_en: Which theory judges actions by whether their consequences maximise overall wellbeing?
clue_et: Milline teooria hindab tegusid selle järgi, kas nende tagajärjed suurendavad üldist heaolu võimalikult palju?
explanation_en: Utilitarianism treats the balance of benefits and harms for everyone affected as morally central.
explanation_et: Utilitarism peab moraalselt keskseks kasu ja kahju tasakaalu kõigi mõjutatud inimeste jaoks.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Ideas in Ethics
clue_en: Which approach emphasises duties and rules rather than judging an act only by its outcome?
clue_et: Milline lähenemine rõhutab kohustusi ja reegleid, mitte üksnes teo tagajärge?
explanation_en: Deontological theories hold that some actions are required or forbidden because of principles and duties.
explanation_et: Deontoloogilised teooriad leiavad, et mõned teod on põhimõtete ja kohustuste tõttu nõutud või keelatud.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Ideas in Ethics
clue_en: Which approach asks what a good person with qualities such as courage and justice would characteristically do?
clue_et: Milline lähenemine küsib, mida teeks iseloomulikult hea inimene, kellel on näiteks julguse ja õigluse voorused?
explanation_en: Virtue ethics focuses on cultivated character and human flourishing rather than a single rule or calculation.
explanation_et: Vooruseetika keskendub kujundatud iseloomule ja inimese õitsengule, mitte ühele reeglile või arvutusele.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Logic and Reasoning
clue_en: What word names a misleading or invalid pattern of argument?
clue_et: Milline sõna tähistab eksitavat või kehtetut arutlusmustrit?
explanation_en: A fallacy can sound persuasive while failing to provide the logical support its conclusion needs.
explanation_et: Arutlusviga võib kõlada veenvalt, kuid ei anna järeldusele vajalikku loogilist tuge.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Logic and Reasoning
clue_en: What kind of reasoning guarantees its conclusion when the premises are true and the argument is valid?
clue_et: Milline arutlusviis tagab järelduse tõesuse, kui eeldused on tõesed ja argument kehtiv?
explanation_en: A valid deductive argument cannot have true premises and a false conclusion.
explanation_et: Kehtival deduktiivsel argumendil ei saa olla tõesed eeldused ja väär järeldus.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Logic and Reasoning
clue_en: What kind of reasoning moves from observed cases to a probable general conclusion?
clue_et: Milline arutlusviis liigub vaadeldud juhtumitest tõenäolise üldise järelduseni?
explanation_en: Inductive support can make a conclusion likely without guaranteeing it, because a new case may differ.
explanation_et: Induktiivne tugi võib muuta järelduse tõenäoliseks, kuid ei taga seda, sest uus juhtum võib erineda.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Logic and Reasoning
clue_en: What three-part argument uses two premises to reach a conclusion, as in the classic example about Socrates being mortal?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse kolmeosalist argumenti, kus kaks eeldust viivad järelduseni, nagu klassikalises näites Sokratese surelikkusest?
explanation_en: A categorical syllogism links terms across a major premise, a minor premise and a conclusion.
explanation_et: Kategooriline süllogism seob mõisted suure eelduse, väikese eelduse ja järelduse kaudu.

category_name_en: Mythology, Religion & Philosophy: Logic and Reasoning
clue_en: Which principle advises preferring the explanation that requires fewer unsupported assumptions?
clue_et: Milline põhimõte soovitab eelistada seletust, mis vajab vähem põhjendamata eeldusi?
explanation_en: Occam’s razor is a rule of parsimony: unnecessary entities or assumptions should not be multiplied.
explanation_et: Ockhami habemenuga on lihtsuse põhimõte: tarbetuid üksusi või eeldusi ei tule juurde tekitada.

explanation_en: Ukko has abode Sky.

explanation_en: Aušrinė has roman Aurora.

explanation_en: Perkūnas has affiliation Sky, thunder, lightning, storms, rain, fire, war, law, order, fertility, mountains, and oak trees.

explanation_en: Aušrinė has greek Eos.
